div.head: Af El. 35
div.ab: Gif þu feoh to borge sylle þinum geferan, þe mid þe eardian wylle, ne nyd þu hine swa nydling ⁊ ne gehyn þu hine mid þy eacan.
Gif ðu fioh to borge selle þinum geferan, þe mid þe eardian wille, ne niede ðu hine swa swa niedling ⁊ ne gehene þu hine mid ðy eacan.
Si pecuniam mutuam dederis populo meo pauperi qui habitat tecum, non urgeas eum quasi exactor nec usuris opprimes.
Gif ðu fioh to borge selle þinum geferan, þe mid þe eardian wille, ne niede ðu hine swa swa niedling ⁊ ne gehene þu hine mid ðy eacan.
If you give property to be borrowed by your fellow, who will dwell with you, do not oppress him like a slave and do not abuse him with interest.
Wenn du deinem Gefährten, der bei dir wohnen mag, Geld zur Leihe giebst, so dränge du ihn nicht so wie einen Sklaven und drücke du ihn nicht mit dem Zinse.
If you give money on loan to your companion who wishes to live with you, do not press him as if he were a slave, and do not oppress him with interest.
